standard: 以游戏主角原图锁定柔和明亮画风；目标约3.3头身、世界主体高3.1格。每人一个固定造型、一张四视图。按每批4款制作，本批刘备、关羽、张飞、孙悟空；其余3款待下一批。

characters.name: 刘备
characters.definition: 温和圆脸、棕色大眼睛，黑色低束髻与细短髭。玉绿色及膝外袍配象牙白交领内衣，简洁小肩甲、棕色腰带、青灰宽松长裤和浅棕短靴；均衡体型。
characters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one FOUR-VIEW definition sheet of ONE single consistent character design, not alternative costumes. Input image1 is the actual game's male protagonist and is the PRIMARY mandatory style and compact anatomy reference. Input image2 is the game's approved protagonist/D1 lineup, secondary confirmation of the same game aesthetic. This is a COSTUME/IDENTITY VARIANT in that existing game, not a new historical illustration aesthetic.
Match the protagonist's bright soft high-quality Japanese-anime 3D game render: large rounded expressive eyes, small simple nose/mouth, soft rounded face contours, sculpted clean hair clumps, clear saturated color areas, clean fabric and smooth materials. Rounded appealing shapes, subtle neutral diffuse shading; no gritty medieval realism, no ink-heavy comic outlines, no tiny ornate patterns, no dark bronze filigree or photoreal pores. Character remains recognizable as the named classical adult male through restrained face and costume cues.
BODY CONTRACT: 3.30 head units from BASE scalp crown to soles, excluding topknot/crown/headwrap decorations and beard. One H is anatomical crown-to-chin, NOT just visible forehead-to-chin. Large cranium matching source hero. Compact torso and limbs; SAME height and broad proportion rhythm as source hero. Neck/torso/pelvis from chin to crotch about1H, crotch to soles1.3H. Short compact limbs, neat narrower calves, modest rounded hands and practical boots. Differences in strength via shoulder/waist width only, never stretching height. All four views identical model, scale, age, face, clothing, limb lengths.
LAYOUT: wide1536x1024 canvas with FOUR whole-body figures evenly spaced in one row: FRONT, exact RIGHT facing image-right, BACK, genuine FRONT45 rotated45degrees with head chest hips and feet together. Camera orthographic-like at same height. Front45 shows both eyes with farther eye smaller, clear nose projecting towards image-right, visible near side and foreshortened torso. Gentle neutral A-pose, both hands and all feet visible, generous10% margin, soles aligned. Pure white background. Exactly FOUR figures, NO extra portraits, accessory diagram, extra character, labels, writing, ruler, grid, shadow under feet or landscape. Weapons omitted from sheet to keep body unobstructed.

CHARACTER DEFINITION:
Liu Bei. Kind adult male, bright brown rounded eyes, soft rounded-square jaw, calm smile, black swept hair with LOW compact tied bun. Only a fine small moustache and tiny separated chin goatee, jaw still visible. Simple ivory cross-collar tunic with jade-green short open coat, thin clean gold border, brown waist belt, dark blue-green trousers, cream/brown low ankle boots. Robe hem near knees rather than hiding all legs. Small plain shoulder guards, NO elaborate armor. Warm friendly gentleman-warrior, slim-balanced width.
characters.measurementNote: 可见基础发冠与下巴轮廓估读，束髻和小山羊胡不计H。

characters.name: 关羽
characters.definition: 沉稳的圆眼和枣红脸，绿色低头巾、黑色长须。深绿战袍配简化金色胸甲与护腕，棕色腰带和短战靴；肩部略宽，保持主角的紧凑四肢。

CHARACTER DEFINITION:
Guan Yu. Adult male general with warm muted reddish complexion (intentional character cue), big calm rounded amber eyes, level bold eyebrows, full rounded cranium. Deep green low close-fitting headcloth no towering knot. Iconic long black smooth tapered beard (three clean sculpted clumps, not wiry) begins UNDER visible jawline. Deep jade green knee-length robe over cream cross-collar inner, simple muted gold chest guard with broad clean panels, brown belt, dark trousers, neat brown boots. Moderately broad shoulders, dignified expression; no terrifying scowl or ultra-muscular limbs. Bright green/gold, NOT blackened medieval armor.
characters.measurementNote: 头巾遮住头顶、长须遮住下颌；头部选点为估读，紫尺只作3.3H目标参考。

characters.name: 张飞
characters.definition: 黑色蓬松短发与红发带，浓眉、大圆眼、爽朗笑容和短络腮胡。赤红短战袍配深灰小肩甲，藏蓝裤、棕金短靴；宽肩厚实，腿部不过度加粗。

CHARACTER DEFINITION:

Short black tousled sculpted hair with small red tie, short rounded black beard below clearly legible chin. Warm medium skin, red jacket with dark charcoal simple armor panels and narrow gold trim, cream cross collar, brown belt, navy compact trousers, brown ankleboots. Stronger shoulder/torso width and forearms, SAME head/height rhythm as hero, NOT thick stump-like legs. Clean cheerful gamehero quality, no tiny scales or dragon filigree.
characters.measurementNote: 束髻不计H，下颌被短须覆盖；紫尺为目标参考，不认证裸头比例。

characters.name: 孙悟空
characters.definition: 金色块状头毛、圆猴耳、奶油色面部和棕金大眼，低金箍。红金短外套、象牙白内衣、腰部小块虎皮、藏蓝裤与绑腿短靴；灵巧体型，细尾巴。

CHARACTER DEFINITION:
Sun Wukong. Adult anthropomorphic monkey hero with lively big rounded gold-brown eyes, warm golden fur, cream smooth monkeyface heart-shaped patch, compact rounded cranium and small rounded monkeyears. Swept golden sculpted hair clumps with low gold circlet, friendly confident closed-mouth smile. Scarlet short jacket with simple gold trim and creaminner, small clean gold chest panel, tigerstripe small waistcloth limited to waist, navy compact trousers, cream legwraps, brown/gold low boots. Slender agile width, SAME3.3 head anatomy as source. One slim curved tail visible in side/back45 attached anatomically to lower back; not oversized. characters.measurementNote: 以基础头毛轮廓估读；高翘毛束、猴耳和尾巴不计H。

characters.name: 猪八戒
characters.definition: Zhu Bajie, classic Journey to the West adult anthropomorphic pig monk, warm peach-pink pig face, big brown round eyes, broad round snout with two nostrils, large soft pig ears, friendly amused expression. Small low black monk cap. Plump cheeks upper arms round belly hips and calves, SAME compact 3.3-head skeleton, do not just enlarge legs. Opaque loose slate-navy monk coat over ivory inner garment, brown sash, wide trousers, brown cloth shoes, belly fully clothed. Small curled pig tail visible in rear view. One detached nine-tooth rake diagram beneath the four fullbody views, exactly nine metal teeth. No greasy skin or grotesque realism.
characters.status: 旧稿已否决·下一批待重绘

characters.name: 沙和尚
characters.definition: Sha Wujing, Sand Monk from classic Journey to the West, adult sturdy calm male with warm medium tan complexion, broad oval face, large dark brown rounded eyes, short brown-red full beard and moustache, reddish-brown short tied hair with low tuft and dark headband. Broad shoulders and stable thick torso, same compact 3.3-head skeleton. Muted dark teal crossed-collar monk robe, brown sleeveless short shoulder vest, large simple wooden prayer beads as a separate necklace, dark sash, wide trousers, leg wraps and cloth shoes. One detached crescent monk staff diagram beneath the four fullbody views. Calm warm and dignified, no scary skull jewelry, no hyperreal muscular anatomy.
characters.status: 旧稿已否决·下一批待重绘

characters.name: 唐三藏
characters.definition: Tang Sanzang, Tripitaka monk from classic Journey to the West, adult gentle slender male with pale warm ivory skin, soft oval face, big round dark brown eyes, straight fine eyebrows, small nose mouth, calm smile, no facial hair. Shaved scalp under a low golden five-petal Buddhist traveling crown. Ivory crossed-collar monk robe, muted red-gold kasaya with clear panel seams and consistent drape from front to back, white socks and brown cloth shoes visible beneath hem. SAME compact 3.3-head game skeleton, no stretched legs, slender by width only. Crown is a detachable accessory excluded from head-length measurement: show anatomical scalp profile clearly at forehead. One detached nine-ring pilgrim staff diagram below the four fullbody views.
characters.status: 旧稿已否决·下一批待重绘
